purpose: Single source of truth for paths that belong to the ANPOS vendor/operator source-management or commercial runtime boundary and must not be retained in initialized customer child repositories or customer-facing commercial-template exports.
rules: Canonical source may retain these paths as inert vendor/operator assets.
scripts/bootstrap_child.py must remove every listed path when initializing a child with --apply.
anpos-commercial-template export must exclude every listed path.
anpos-commercial-service export remains sourced only from committed commercial-service/ blobs and strips that prefix.
No untracked/local secrets may be copied by either bootstrap/export flow.
GitHub Marketplace App and Vendor Distribution App blueprints are vendor-only launch architecture and must not leak into customer templates.
Operator launch bootstrap tooling may accept only non-secret setup inputs and must never accept, print, or persist live credentials.

Vendor handoff verification must reconstruct the approved deterministic export from committed canonical Git blobs and reject extra, missing, dirty, stale, tampered, wrong-mode, or wrong-identity vendor repository content.
Deployment identity verification is vendor-only launch assurance and must reject stale/wrong service artifacts before production readiness can be certified.
Removing vendor-only paths must not remove core ANPOS child development, security, quality, PM, AI selection, or non-secret entitlement-reference functionality.
